header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: he will say. So those people will come to me, and I will say, (“Very well) “The right to intercede has been given to me.’ After that I will ask my Lord for permission, and permission will be granted. At that time Allah will inspire in my heart words of praise which I cannot say now. Praising Allah with those words, I will fall into sajdah. It will be said, “O Muhammad! Raise your head!’ “Speak, your words will be heard; ask! it will be given; intercede! your intercession will be accepted.” I will say, “My Lord! My Ummah, my Ummah (forgive my Ummah).’ It will be said, “Bring out of the Fire whoever has Iman in his heart equal to a grain of barley!’ Then I will carry out what I was commanded, return, praise Allah with the same words and fall into sajdah. When it is said, “O Muhammad! Raise your head! Speak, it will be heard; ask, it will be given; your intercession will be accepted,” I will say, “My Lord! My (Ummah), my (Ummah).’ It will be said (to me), “Go! Bring out also whoever has Iman in his heart equal to a mustard seed!’ I will go and carry out what I was commanded. I will return, praise Allah Ta'ala with the same words and fall into sajdah. It will be said, “O Muhammad! Raise your head! Speak, it will be heard; ask, it will be given; what you intercede for will be accepted.’ I will say, “My Lord! My Ummah, my Ummah.” It will be said, “O Muhammad!
